title: git-vouch: add 'git vouch keys <email>'
description: Core command for the patatt fork (METARULE 2: tools talk via CLI, not imports). Given an email, if it is an endorsed email of a registered person (any tier, bots included per P2/P3), print that person's current keys, one per line: '<selector> <ssh public key>' with the derived selector (P4: 'k-' + short fingerprint). Exit 1 if the email is not endorsed or unknown. Uses the configured registry copy and check's result; revoked and retired keys never printed.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with fixture registries: endorsed email prints current keys with stable selectors; retired/revoked keys absent; unendorsed or unknown email exits 1; selector derivation matches a hand-computed value from ssh-keygen -l output (independent oracle).
